item.title: VOLZ raises Algeria’s largest startup funding round in local currency
item.description: VOLZ, an Algerian travel-tech startup, has raised 600 million dinars (about $5 million) to strengthen its product offerings within the country and expand into new markets across North and West Africa.

item.title: What Senegal’s tech ecosystem can teach Francophone Africa about scale
item.description: Senegal is charting a new chapter in its tech ecosystem. After producing Francophone Africa’s first unicorn, the country is now layering public and private capital to help startups scale sustainably, offering lessons for the rest of the region.

item.title: How Swypt turns M-PESA payments into stablecoins without changing how Kenyans pay
item.description: Kenyan fintech Swypt connects M-PESA payments to stablecoins by letting merchants receive, hold, and send USDT without changing how customers pay.

item.title: Chowdeck taps GoLemon to supply dark stores in new instant delivery push
item.description: GoLemon has partnered with Chowdeck to supply groceries to Chowdeck’s dark stores and offer customers same-day grocery delivery through Chowdeck.

item.title: Why Toyin Akinniyi believes African tech’s biggest problem is silos
item.description: Africa’s tech ecosystem is building cars without brakes. Toyin Akinniyi, Luminate Group's Regional Portfolio Director, Africa explains why builders, policymakers, and civil society must break their silos to ensure technology serves—not harms—Africans.

item.title: As US doors narrow, African tech talent faces a tougher path to America
item.description: Founders already inside the US system remain shielded from the executive order. But first-time entrants will face a wall built from data, security logic, and bureaucracy that hamper migration opportunities for African talent. This could encourage a shift toward alternative hubs in Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, where visa access is predictable.

item.title: In Nigeria’s trust-starved domestic work market, Shaaré bets on instant matching
item.description: Shaaré, a Nigerian home service marketplace has launched instant matching feature to automatically connect cleaners to users.
